description: PPRN de la commune de L Houmeau ( - erosion cotiere et ) is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geostandards.developpement-durable.gouv.fr. This plan for the prevention of natural hazards (PPRN) concerns the municipality of Houmeau and was approved by prefectural decree of 11/12/20. The different layers present in this data set are as follows: scope of exposure to the risk of the PPRN; PPRN Restricted Area. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "PPRN of the municipality of L Houmeau (Coastal rivers — coastal erosion and marine submersion)" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include usage des sols, risque naturel, données ouvertes, pprn, inondation, périmètre. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
